Effective Fed Funds Rate Holds at 3.62% as Policy Calibration Continues

FRED's latest effective federal funds reading was 3.62% on 2026-07-08 inside the 3.50% to 3.75% target range, keeping the policy-transmission question in focus.

https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/effective-fed-funds-rate-holds-at

Why it matters: The effective federal funds rate is the volume-weighted median of overnight unsecured transactions between depository institutions.

For informational purposes only; not financial advice.

Policy context: The target range and administered rates frame the overnight operating environment. Cross-asset context: The overnight benchmark matters for cash and short-rate pricing.
